    Dout, Hout, Wout,

    BLOCK_T: tl.constexpr,
    BLOCK_T_INNER: tl.constexpr,
    BLOCK_OC: tl.constexpr,
    BLOCK_IC: tl.constexpr,
):

    pid_oc = tl.program_id(1)
    pid_n = tl.program_id(2).to(tl.int64)

    num_wtiles = (Wout + BLOCK_T - 1) // BLOCK_T

    pid_w = pid_lin % num_wtiles
    tmp = pid_lin // num_wtiles
    oy = (tmp % Hout).to(tl.int64)
    oz = (tmp // Hout).to(tl.int64)
    ox_start = (pid_w * BLOCK_T).to(tl.int64)
    tl.static_assert(BLOCK_T % BLOCK_T_INNER == 0)

    ocmask = offs_oc < Cout

    CoG = Cout // G

    oc_group = offs_oc // CoG

                        ic_offsets = (ic0 + tl.arange(0, BLOCK_IC)).to(tl.int64)
                        icmask = ic_offsets < Cin

                            w_ptr
                            + (ic_offsets[None, :] * w_stride_ci)
                            + (oc_within[:, None] * w_stride_co)
                            + base_w_k
                        )

            + base_out_n
            + (offs_oc[:, None] * out_stride_c)
            + (oz * out_stride_d)
            + (oy * out_stride_h)
            + (ox[None, :] * out_stride_w)
